description: This file defines the IReadFilter interface used in the PhpSpreadsheet library to specify filtering behavior when reading spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: IReadFilter
classes.description: An interface that declares a method to determine whether a specific cell in a spreadsheet should be read based on its location and worksheet.

methods.name: readCell
methods.description: Determines if a particular cell identified by column, row, and optionally worksheet name, should be read. Returns a boolean.
